messages:
anya: dropped a concise mock: left-rail vs stacked card for token breakdown. prototype: https://redwood.design/p/rail-vs-card :eyes:
dave: quick take: left-rail feels faster for scanning many projects; stacked card wins on narrow screens.
sam: agree with dave. also request: persist denom (tokens/USD) when switching scope. resetting is jarring. :exclamation:
kyle: a11y: contrast on legend swatches low in dark theme. use token-neutral-300 bg. also add aria-label to the scope toggle.
olivia: invoice placement: prefer context-sensitive CTA (project vs org). non-admins should see disabled state with tooltip explaining permission.
billing-bot: note: invoices API returns 404 for months not finalized and for non-admins. map to friendly states: "Invoice not available yet" or "Access restricted".
anya: plan: 1) left-rail for desktop, stacked collapsible card on mobile; remember collapse state per user. 2) persist denom per user. 3) contextual invoice CTA + disabled tooltip. 4) aria & contrast fixes. I'll update figma and ship a tiny A/B tomorrow.
dave: looks good. we should also debounce scope changes before re-rendering charts (200ms) to avoid thrash.
